payload.summary: WA MHA Form 6A/6B print component: obtain legal/clinical sign-off or remove after 13 Nov 2026 (follow-up to #WFYDV6)
payload.detail: PR #3573 replaced official Department of Health branding with non-statutory study headers and corrected Form 6B report wording in src/components/forms/wa-mha-form-print.tsx, but the unverified statutory section lists, 7-day pre-expiry examination timing, and copy recipients still require either verified WA MHA 2014 legal/clinical sign-off or component removal after the 30-day dead-code window on 2026-11-13.
